article.headline: The Title Could End in Singapore — Antonelli's Championship Math Heading Into the Sprint

research.facts:
Antonelli Championship Clinch Math at Singapore
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- Antonelli leads championship: 320 pts [multiple sources: Racing News 365, Crash.net, Motorsport Week, Yahoo Sports]
- Russell 2nd: 236 pts [same sources]
- Gap: 84 pts [Racing News 365, Crash.net headline: "crushing blow for Russell"]
- Singapore GP dates: Oct 9-11, 2026 [Formula1.com, ESPN, Motorsport.com]
- Singapore Sprint format: Sprint + Race weekend; Sprint race 8 pts max, Race 25 pts max; total 33 pts max per Sprint weekend [Sprint weekend structure — standard F1]
- This is the final Sprint weekend of the 2026 season [Racing News 365 Singapore preview]
**Clinch math (derived — label MEDIUM):**
- Remaining max for Russell at Singapore: 33 pts (Sprint win + Race win)
- If Russell gets max 33, gap reduces to 51 pts
- Remaining rounds after Singapore: need at least 3 more rounds (Singapore is Round 17) for 84-pt gap to remain unassailable
- From 09-28 pipeline: "scenario: Antonelli wins Sprint + race, Russell outside points = title" — this was the clinch at Singapore per prior research
- MEDIUM: exact clinch calculation depends on total remaining rounds
